name: Frog-Footman
timbre: flat, thick, croaky man's voice, stolid and deadpan, slightly throaty
accent: liveried servant's affected formal English over a flat provincial base
reference_style: Solemn, imperturbable doorman who repeats the invitation with the words re-ordered and philosophises uselessly from the doorstep, 'in the same tone, exactly as if nothing had happened' while plates fly past.

deadpan_unchanged.note: ch006-p11 — stays flat even as a plate grazes his nose

voice_evidence.quote: The Frog-Footman repeated, in the same solemn tone
the Footman continued in the same tone, exactly as if nothing had happened

reason: Solemn unchanging tone sourced; croaky low timbre is the frog-coded vocal touch. Per SUP-002 as amended by BIB-0027 (user ruling 2026-09-22) the Frog-Footman is a photoreal CGI frog-bodied figure in livery (anatomy pending_H2, owned by 04-creatures/creature + 03-characters/appearance), not a human performer; he still speaks fully articulate English (SUP-002 sound_signature), synced to naturalistic frog-mouth movement, with any species vocalisation limited to a light tic (a faint throat-pouch gulp) under otherwise normal dialogue. Voice design unchanged by BIB-0027.
